==Summary==

{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

Egwene is with [[Gareth Bryne]] watching supply ships coming down the river to [[Tar Valon]]. The [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] haven't been able to stop the city from being resupplied by ship although they do hold all of the land approaches. Gareth requests that Egwene begin an assault using Gateways to put his men into the city but she does not want open conflict between the two [[Aes Sedai]] groups. The chain blocking the harbor drops, allowing the ships to enter the harbor but preventing an attacking force from entry. [[Delana]] talks with Egwene as they ride back to camp, giving her advice and probing to find out her plans and who her real allies are among the Aes Sedai.

Yesterday, Egwene sent a small group of Aes Sedai to investigate the vast channeling that took place a few days before.

Delana mentions some Sitters are interested in opening negotiations with Elaida on how to reunite the tower. Egwene gives [[Beonin]] permission to open negotiations despite advice to the contrary by Delana and most of her advisors. As the Aes Sedai begin arguing against her decision, Egwene sets the terms she will accept: [[Elaida]] is to resign as Amyrlin Seat and go into exile. This statement causes Beonin to faint but Egwene knows that Elaida will never accept her terms. She hopes that she has enough time for her plan to succeed in reuniting the [[The White Tower|tower]].
